about.title: Hughson Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Hughson is a small town, and when someone here dies because of another person's carelessness, the loss ripples through a community of about 7,400 people. Public records show 12 injury collisions on Hughson roads in 2025, with 15 people hurt and no traffic deaths that year. A fatal outcome can come from many directions: a crash on Hatch Road or Whitmore Avenue, a fall at a workplace, a medication error, a defective product, or negligence at a care facility. California law gives certain surviving family members a civil path to hold the responsible party accountable. That path is separate from any criminal charges, and it moves on its own clock, generally two years from the date of death, with a shorter window when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that listens to what happened and connects you with an independent wrongful death attorney who handles these claims on contingency. There is no charge to you unless the attorney secures a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Hughson Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can sort out who in your family has the right to bring the claim before anyone files paperwork.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: The general filing deadline is two years from the date of death, and it shrinks considerably when a city, county, or state agency may share fault. Getting connected promptly protects that window.

items.title: A full picture of your losses
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Nothing about the introduction costs you money; the attorney is paid only from a recovery.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on Hatch Road in Hughson. Does the driver being cited or charged affect our claim?
items.answer: A criminal case and a wrongful death claim are two separate proceedings. Prosecutors decide whether to file charges; your family decides whether to pursue a civil action, and one does not depend on the other. Evidence from a police report or criminal case can still be useful, so an attorney will typically want to review it. Hughson collisions cluster on Friday evenings, and records from that time frame can help reconstruct what occurred.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law puts a surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children first in line. If there are none, certain financially dependent relatives or other heirs may qualify. Because standing rules can be complicated in blended or extended families, it helps to have an attorney confirm who should be named before a claim is filed.

items.question: How long do we have, and does it matter that Hughson is in Stanislaus County?
items.answer: In most cases, a wrongful death action must be filed within two years of the date of death. If a government entity such as the county, a school district, or a state agency may be responsible, a formal claim usually has to be presented much sooner, often within months. An attorney can identify early whether any public agency is involved so the shorter deadline is not missed.
